📋 Import Guidelines

  • company_name is mandatory for every row.
  • Existing vendors matching an identical company name will be safely skipped to avoid duplicates.
  • Categories not already in the system will be automatically registered for you.
  • Vendor identification codes (e.g. VEN-00001) will be generated automatically.
  • Ensure dates, phone numbers, and GSTIN / PAN format follow Indian standard conventions.
